author: JD2
quote: The graphic effects are excellent, but that’s where it ends. The story is the worst—it’s all the more unpleasant because the intent behind writing the script this way is all too obvious. By incorporating some of the less desirable elements from RDR2, the game ends up being incredibly cumbersome to play.Perhaps it might suit someone looking for a "reality simulator."If this game had been released under a different name, I might have rated it higher, but this simply cannot be called GTA.
